tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the WAXED vinyl marketplace and catalog. Returns mixed results (records, artists, stores, labels, genres, crates) ranked by relevance. Record results include listing counts and minimum price when copies are for sale. Catalog numbers also match.

Prices are in USD cents.

tools.name: browse_marketplace

tools.name: get_price_estimate
tools.description: Estimate the market price (USD) of a release by Discogs release id, optionally adjusted for media condition (1=Poor … 5=Mint) and buyer country. Returns price_usd, confidence tier, and the adjustment factors used.

tools.name: get_price_history
tools.description: Get real historical sales for a release by Discogs release id: individual past sales (price, currency, date, condition) plus aggregate stats and the Discogs low/median/high range. mode "exact" = this pressing only; "all_versions" = every pressing of the master.

tools.name: get_store

tools.name: get_shared_wishlist

tools.name: get_artist

tools.name: get_label

tools.name: get_crate
tools.description: Get a WAXED crate by id: a dealer-curated bundle of records sold together. Returns the full item list (each record with artist, title, release id, and price), the total bundle price in USD cents, item count, genres, and the country the crate ships from.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.waxed.market" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_order, my_profile, my_conversations, get_conversation · Private data: search, get_shared_wishlist, get_label, get_crate, create_crate, update_order_status, square_status · Public sink: get_shared_wishlist, update_crate, publish_crate, square_status, my_profile, update_profile, send_message · Destructive: browse_marketplace, set_listing_status, delete_listing, bulk_update_listings, delete_crate, modify_crate_items.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_order, my_profile, my_conversations, get_conversation · Private data: search, get_shared_wishlist, get_label, get_crate, create_crate, update_order_status, square_status · Public sink: get_shared_wishlist, update_crate, publish_crate, square_status, my_profile, update_profile, send_message · Destructive: browse_marketplace, set_listing_status, delete_listing, bulk_update_listings, delete_crate, modify_crate_items

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
